_note: Per-1M-token USD prices used to meter proxied calls and to auto-price POST /v1/track. 'verified' means the number was read off the provider's OWN pricing page on the as_of date — it does not mean anyone is watching for changes. Optional cache rates: cache_hit for input read from cache, cache_write_5m / cache_write_1h for input written into cache. A model with no cache rates charges every input token the standard rate, which is the conservative direction for a spend cap but WRONG for a cache-heavy workload: Claude's cache reads cost 0.1x and its 1-hour cache writes cost 2x, so a cache-dominated Claude Code session priced at the flat input rate is off by more than an order of magnitude in the wrong direction. An unlisted model is never blocked: the call passes through, tokens are recorded, an alert fires. GET /v1/pricing reports exactly what is loaded, and how many entries are unverified.
